b: Throughout life I've had friends at different stages but nothing ever seems to stick long term (e.g. work friends, school friends). I'm good with conversations with family/ people I know well. But I've never been the life of the party and definitely struggle with small talk/mingling. I actively avoid events where there may be an open/unstructured social event where mingling is expected (e.g. x-mas or Halloween party). I prefer structured socializing where people may be put in groups/ focus on a task,etc.

However, I really do want to build a small group of 4-5 like minded people who are not loud-mouth people, just to hang out with (walks, coffee, maybe sports like tennis/bowling/pickleball). But all I come across are extroverted and loud people everywhere.
Where are the quieter people like me? I've even setup meetups and reached out on Reddit, but seems there's no interest?
